about_the_game:
Overspelled is a top-down survival rougelite where you play as a wizard gathering arrays of spells to fight hordes of monsters. Summon allies, cast curses and annihilate enemies with magic you are probably unable to wield... or are you?

Unlock Spells & Fight Monsters:

Scorch enemies with orbiting fireballs, stun them with traps or burn them down with magic beams. As you obliterate foes, collect their souls and choose from dozens of unique, active abilities to control the battlefield. Spells are cast automatically, so you can focus on positioning and aiming.

Combat a variety of evil creatures spawning randomly on a closed arena. Hunt down the bosses to win and make progress.

Upgrade:

Enhance your abilities. Every spell or upgrade comes with both advantages and disadvantages, so choose your powers wisely and be sure that no 2 runs will be the same.

Gather Magic Staffs:

As you play, you permamently unlock magic staffs. Staffs provide unique passive advantages that change the temper of your runs.

Survive!

Will you be able to survive until the boss arrives and hunt it down to claim its soul? Each run a boss spawns after a certain time. Defeat it to win the attempt and move on to the next world.

Features:

  • Dozens of unique, auto-activated spells.

  • Fast runs: between 10 and 25 minutes.

  • Survive an increasing onslaught of foes to collect souls and level up.

  • Every time you level up, you get to choose one from randomly picked spells and upgrades in the shop.

  • Each upgrade and spell comes with advantages and disadvantages.

  • Permanently unlockable magic staffs alter the temper of runs.

Note: All artists are credited in-game.
